newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Q1 fixed asset investment up 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Q1 fixed asset investment up 21 percent.

text.p: Shanghai's fixed asset investment increased by a year-on-year 21 percent to 21.047 billion yuan in the first three months of this year, the Business News said on Wednesday.
A total of 4.82 billion yuan was invested in infrastructure projects in the first quarter, an increase of 93 percent against the same period of last year, the newspaper said.
The projects included the city's second subway, a flyover on East Yanan Road, the Shanghai-Hangzhou expressway and a water project on the upper Huangpu River, the newspaper said.
